result.title: Graphene: A Lightweight Transformer with Ising Mean-Field Refinement for Image Super-Resolution
result.summary: This paper proposes Graphene, a lightweight image super-resolution architecture with two complementary feature refinement mechanisms: Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement using an Ising Refinement Block (IRB) and stage-history-based feature refinement using a History Attention (HistAttn) module. The IRB reuses attention output features and pre-softmax attention logits to construct signed pairwise token couplings within each local window, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and refines features through a gated residual correction. These signed couplings allow alignment and opposition between latent spins to modulate local feature refinement. HistAttn attends over the current stage output and earlier representations at the same token position and adaptively blends the current stage output with a history-weighted feature aggregate without adding spatial pairwise attention. On Urban100 at $\times4$, Graphene and Graphene-light improve over IET and IET-light by 0.24 dB and 0.38 dB, respectively, with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 78.4%/71.5% lower latency, and 76.0%/85.5% lower peak memory. Real-world SR comparisons further show that Graphene recovers fine details and preserves textures across diverse degradations. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/Graphene

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Graphene 轻量级图像超分架构，包含受 Ising 模型启发的局部特征细化块（复用注意力输出与 pre-softmax logits 构造带符号 token 耦合，做展开式平均场更新加门控残差修正）与跨阶段 History Attention，在更少参数、FLOPs 和延迟下提升超分效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其带符号耦合的展开式平均场迭代更新与门控残差修正，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的迭代更新与收敛式设计提供结构线索；History Attention 同位置跨阶段复用表示也可供核查 latent 相似度中深度与缓存因素，但任务是图像超分，不涉及推理决策或证据获取。
